Stay Active Together Do you enjoy being active with your dog but want to keep your hands free? Our waist belt lets you focus fully on your workout while your dog runs safely by your side. The belt is adjustable and offers a comfortable fit thanks to its wide neoprene padding. The dog lead is attached to the front of the waist belt via a ring, which takes the strain off the buckle. A shock absorber integrated into the lead cushions your dog’s sudden pulls, making it more comfortable for both you and your four-legged friend. The lead is continuously adjustable, so you can adjust the distance tbetween you and your dog. With the help of the snap buckles, the lead can be quickly and easily detached or attached. The upper part of the lead can also be used as a lead with a hand strap for normal walking. Thanks to reflective elements on harness and lead, you will be clearly visible even at dusk or in the dark. Enjoy your activities together without restrictions!
